name: Annual Survey of Industrial Firms (ASIF; China Industrial Enterprise Database)
provider: National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBS); researchers often obtain processed editions through CAJ, CNRDS, or CSMAR
domains: firm; trade; IO; development; macro; labor; innovation
unit_of_observation: Firm-year (unbalanced panel; firms are linked across years using enterprise identifiers)
strongest_use: Productivity, entry and exit, ownership and policy impacts of industrial enterprises above designated size from 1998 to 2013

name: China Family Panel Studies (CFPS)
provider: Institute of Social Science Survey, Peking University (ISSS, Institute of Social Science Survey, Peking University)
domains: labor; development; health; education; consumption; public; sociology; demography
unit_of_observation: Individual-year/Family-year/Community-year (three-tier tracking design)
strongest_use: Whole-family tracking from childhood to old age, as well as joint research on income, education, health and family relationships

name: China General Social Survey (CGSS)
provider: National Survey Research Center at Renmin University of China (NSRC, National Survey Research Center at Renmin University of China)
domains: sociology; public; labor; health; governance; development; demography
unit_of_observation: Individuals (Adults 18+) - Years (repeated cross-section, non-trace panel)
strongest_use: Nationally replicated cross-section of adult social attitudes, trust in government, sense of fairness, subjective class, and values

name: China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS)
provider: National School of Development, Peking University (NSD, National School of Development, Peking University)
domains: health; labor; development; public; aging; consumption; sociology
unit_of_observation: Individual-year/Family-year/Community-year (middle-aged and elderly people aged 45 and above and their spouses)
strongest_use: Health, cognition, retirement, pensions and intergenerational care in people aged 45 and over, including physical and selected biomarkers

name: China Household Finance Survey (CHFS)
provider: Survey and Research Center for China Household Finance (SWUFE), Southwestern University of Finance and Economics
domains: finance; labor; consumption; housing; development; public
unit_of_observation: Household-Year/Individual-Year (Tracking Panel Design)
strongest_use: A balance sheet study of household properties, financial assets, liabilities, credit constraints, and entrepreneurship

name: China National Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Data (CNEMC/MEE)
provider: China Environmental Monitoring Center (CNEMC) and Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE)
domains: environment; health; public; urban; finance
unit_of_observation: Monitoring station-hour/city-day/city-month
strongest_use: Short-term air pollution exposure at city or monitoring station level

name: China Census (Population Census/National 1% Population Sample Survey)
provider: National Bureau of Statistics (NBS, National Bureau of Statistics of China)
domains: labor; demography; development; public; macro; health; education
unit_of_observation: Individual/family household/collective household (micro level); can be aggregated to counties/cities/provinces
time_span: Large census: 1990 (fourth census)/2000 (fifth census)/2010 (sixth census)/2020 (seventh census); minor census (1%): 1995/2005/2015; and 1982 (third census) and earlier historical censuses
access_cost: Summary table: free (published on the National Bureau of Statistics website); Micro data: by-application (academic research only, confidentiality agreement required)
strongest_use: County/city/provincial measures of population migration matrix, sex ratio and population structure

name: China Customs Trade Statistics (CCTS)
provider: General Administration of Customs of China; researchers often obtain the processed version through the EPS China Microeconomic Data Query System
domains: trade; IO; firm; development; macro
unit_of_observation: Enterprise-Product-Import and Export Country-Transaction (at the level of customs declaration, which can be summed up to Enterprise-Year/Product-Year)
time_span: 2000–2017 (different platform versions vary slightly, core range 2000–2016)
strongest_use: Extended/intensive margin, product quality and global value chain measures of firm-product-destination trade

name: Environmental Survey of Industrial Firms
provider: Department of Ecology and Environment and National Statistics Department; research often uses academic institutions or commercial platforms to compile versions
domains: environment; firm; development; IO; trade
unit_of_observation: Enterprise-Year
strongest_use: The impact of environmental regulations on corporate emissions, productivity, employment, entry and exit

name: China Input-Output Tables
provider: National Bureau of Statistics (NBS); Chinese Academy of Sciences/National Information Center and other institutions prepare inter-provincial/multi-regional extended version
domains: IO; trade; macro; firm; environment; development
unit_of_observation: industry-industry (product division × product division) or province-industry-province-industry (interprovincial/multi-regional version)
strongest_use: Industry upstream and downstream input relationships, inter-provincial trade flows and structural model calibration

name: China Land Market Data (China Land Transaction Data/China Land Transfer Data)
provider: Public announcement on the China Land Market Network (www.landchina.com) under the Ministry of Natural Resources (MNR, formerly the Ministry of Land and Resources MLR)
domains: public; urban; housing; firm; development; macro; environment; finance
unit_of_observation: Land plot-transaction (land transfer/transfer records one by one)
time_span: 2000-present (data coverage and quality improved significantly after the implementation of the bidding, auction and listing system in 2006; continuously updated)
access_cost: free (original disclosure information is public data; Batch scraping or structured data must be handled manually)
strongest_use: Plot-level land transfer prices, uses, methods and local government land supply behavior

name: China Patent Data (CNIPA / SIPO)
provider: National Intellectual Property Office (CNIPA, formerly SIPO); researchers often obtain processed versions through CSMAR/CNRDS/Hexiang Xinchuang/Patentics/Google Patents, etc.
domains: innovation; firm; finance; trade; IO; development
unit_of_observation: Patent-year (patent-by-patent level); can be summed to company-year/industry-year/city-year
access_cost: Original data: free (publicly available by CNIPA); Processed version: paid (subscriptions from CSMAR/CNRDS/Hexiang New Startups, etc.)
strongest_use: Enterprise/city innovation output, technology classification, inventor network and patent legal status

name: China pollution data (old mixed entry, split)
provider: multiple
domains: environment
strongest_use: needs completion

name: Chinese satellite retrieval and fusion of PM2.5 data
provider: Multiple independent products; including global satellite retrieval grid and Tracking Air Pollution in China (TAP) fusion product
domains: environment; health; migration; urban; development
unit_of_observation: Grid-day / Grid-year (can be summed to counties, cities, and provinces)
strongest_use: Long-term, nationwide continuous PM2.5 exposure before and after monitoring station construction

name: China Statistical Yearbook System (including statistical yearbooks at national/provincial/municipal/county levels)
provider: National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) and provincial/municipal statistical bureaus
domains: macro; development; public; labor; trade; finance; demography; IO
unit_of_observation: National/provincial/city/county-year (aggregated statistics, not micro)
strongest_use: Provincial/city/county annual macro panel, regional results of policy DID and control variables

name: Chinese Enterprise Tax Survey Microdata
provider: China Enterprise Tax Investigation; The verified institutional/commercial versions are held by universities or provided by platforms, and the original investigation authorities and unified application channels still need to be verified.
domains: tax; public-finance; firm; finance; trade; innovation
unit_of_observation: Enterprise-year (the cross-year connectability and desensitization rules of different holding versions need to be verified separately)
strongest_use: Microscopic research on corporate tax burden, tax system reform, tax collection and management, tax incentives and business operations/investment/innovation

name: Chinese Household Income Project (CHIP)
provider: China Household Income Survey Project; organized by the School of Economics and Business Administration of Beijing Normal University since 2007, and has cooperated with the survey system of the National Bureau of Statistics for several rounds
domains: labor; development; consumption; inequality; poverty; public
unit_of_observation: Individual/Family (three subsamples of urban, rural and post-2002 floating population)
strongest_use: Long historical repeated cross-section of income distribution, poverty, wages and urban-rural gap in China from 1988 to 2018

name: China Health and Nutrition Survey (CHNS)
provider: Jointly implemented by the UNC Carolina Population Center and the Institute of Nutrition and Health, Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (NINH, China CDC)
domains: health; nutrition; labor; development; demography; sociology
unit_of_observation: Individual-Year/Family-Year/Community-Year (Track Panel Design)
strongest_use: Long panel of dietary intake, food prices, body measurements, and nutritional health since 1989

name: China Migrants Dynamic Survey (CMDS)
provider: National Health Commission (NHC, formerly National Health and Family Planning Commission) Migrant Population Service Center
domains: labor; migration; health; development; sociology; public
unit_of_observation: Individual-year (migrant population over 15 years old who has lived in the place of arrival for more than one month; repeated cross-sectional design)
strongest_use: Large-sample annual repeated cross-sections of employment, residence, medical insurance, children's education and social integration of floating population from 2009 to 2018

name: Guotai'an CSMAR China Economic and Financial Research Database
provider: Shenzhen Xishma Data Technology Co., Ltd.
domains: finance; accounting; firm; governance; innovation; macro
unit_of_observation: Listed companies - day/month/quarter/year; securities - trading day; directors/executives - term of office; events - announcement date; macro indicators - period
strongest_use: Research on finance, corporate governance, accounting and capital market events of Chinese listed companies

name: ERA5-Land land surface reanalysis meteorological data (ERA5-Land)
provider: Copernicus Climate Change Service（C3S）/ European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts（ECMWF）
domains: environment; climate; geography; health; agriculture; urban; labor
unit_of_observation: Regular latitude and longitude grid-hour (can be aggregated by user into day/month or administrative area-period)
strongest_use: Long-term, continuous, and spatially matchable exposure to high temperature, precipitation, wind speed, and soil moisture in China

name: National Rural Fixed Point Survey (NFP/NFPS)
provider: Research Center for Rural Economy, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs (RCRE, formerly Research Center for Rural Economy, Ministry of Agriculture)
domains: agriculture; development; labor; land; public; migration
unit_of_observation: Farmer-year/Family member-year/Farmer-crop-year/Village-year
strongest_use: A long-term panel study on rural land allocation, land rental and farmer household productivity

name: National Bureau of Statistics Rural Household Survey (RHS)
provider: National Bureau of Statistics Rural Household Survey System
domains: development; labor; consumption; poverty; agriculture
unit_of_observation: Farmer-year/Family member-year
strongest_use: Long-term annual analysis of rural household income, consumption, poverty and labor supply

name: China Urban Household Survey (UHS)
provider: National Bureau of Statistics (NBS, National Bureau of Statistics of China)
domains: labor; development; public; consumption; health; education; macro
unit_of_observation: Household-Year/Individual-Year/Journal (three-layer structure, flexible aggregation)
time_span: 1986–2015 (the commonly used version in academia ends around 2009; there are major changes in measurement definition around 2002)
strongest_use: NBS annual historical micro-study of urban household income, consumption, and employment, especially the design of mandatory retirement age

name: Wind financial terminal
provider: Wind Information Co., Ltd.
domains: finance; accounting; macro; firm; trade
unit_of_observation: Listed companies - daily/quarterly/annual; Macro indicators - monthly/quarterly/yearly; Banks - quarterly/yearly; Bonds - days; Fund - Day (Multi-level Structure)
access_cost: paid (institutional subscription, prices close to Bloomberg but lower for Chinese customers)
strongest_use: High-frequency data from China's capital markets, bonds, banking, and macroeconomics, as well as bulk query via terminal/API
